theme: A wide-open day in St. Pete, and a trip runway stacked with P1s.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan — nothing scheduled at all. It is the kind of open day that is best aimed at the Croatia trip, where a handful of P1 bookings have started to pile up against real deadlines.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night for Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: The last night of the trip still has no room — one in Cavtat (airport side, not Old Town) for Sat Sept 19, plus the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer. On the Mike + Dan board, due today; the real cutoff is Sept 8, since you book from land before sailing and there is no connectivity aboard.

needsAttention.title: St. Pete landing gap, Sept 20-22
needsAttention.detail: Two nights in St. Pete (the 20th and 21st) after you land from Croatia and before the Orlando villa are still unbooked, one day overdue on the board. Worth a glance too that the Sept 27 St. Pete Airbnb flipped from pending to confirmed.

needsAttention.title: Get checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's own site and buy bags online now if they are not included — two 55L duffels will not fly as carry-on, and counter fees run high. One day overdue on the board.

needsAttention.title: The four girls' passport packet
needsAttention.detail: Mike's packet is due on the board today so the appointment before Aug 28 does not fail: DS-11s printed and left unsigned, birth-certificate copies, and a State Dept check or money order, since cards are not taken at the counter.

needsAttention.title: Valoris call at noon
needsAttention.detail: Martin Steindl's Teams call lands at noon tomorrow — the one fixed thing on an otherwise open runway, worth arriving with a clear read on what you want out of Valoris.

flagged.title: Nautilus sailing balance due
flagged.detail: Invoice 2170 for $6,475 is out, and Amy has flagged it as the final course payment ahead of the September trip.

flagged.title: SVP Global Public Policy — interview step
flagged.detail: A SourceHire message on REQ64085 asks you to confirm work authorization to keep the application moving; the link is third-party, so it is worth eyeing carefully before entering anything.

flagged.title: Kuala Lumpur invite from Kevin Waring
flagged.detail: CGI's Kevin Waring asks if you would come along to the KL event to meet a new corporate audience; speaker slots are filled but attending is open, and a reply is owed.

inbox.noise: The rest is Labor Day sales, newsletters, and trip confirmations.

recipe.title: Sautéed zucchini with scallions & fresh mozzarella
recipe.why: Peak summer squash is everywhere right now, so keep it quick and let the mozzarella do the rest.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar before noon — a clear, uninterrupted stretch.
Still wide open; likely the longest free block of the week.
The girls are with you in St. Pete tonight, and tomorrow opens with the noon Valoris call.
